plans.title: Complete video.controller.js - Media Sharing Platform backend
plans.purpose: Complete the unfinished video.controller.js functions (getAllVideos, publishAVideo, getVideoById, updateVideo, deleteVideo, togglePublishStatus) at a medium-complexity standard consistent with the existing user/tweet controllers, and wire them into the app (routes + app.js registration).

steps.content: Fix broken import path in video.controller.js
steps.context: Fixed as part of rewriting the full video.controller.js file.
steps.implementation_outline: video.controller.js imports from '../utils/ApiError.js' but the actual file is 'ApiErrors.js' (matches user/tweet controllers) - correct the import so the module can even load
steps.verification: Manual review: grep confirms ApiErrors.js is the only ApiError-related file in src/utils/; import path now matches exactly. No execution environment available for this Thrilia-connected project (Node.js runs on user's machine) - real verification is `npm run dev` starting without a module-not-found error, which the user should run.
steps.outcome: Corrected import from '../utils/ApiError.js' to '../utils/ApiErrors.js' matching the actual filename used by user.controller.js and tweet.controller.js.

steps.context: Implemented in the same video.controller.js rewrite.
steps.implementation_outline: Pagination (page/limit), optional title/description search via query, optional filter by userId owner, optional sortBy/sortType, only return isPublished videos unless owner is requesting their own, use mongoose-aggregate-paginate-v2 plugin already on the model
steps.verification: Manual review against model schema and existing aggregatePaginate usage pattern. Real verification: GET /api/v1/videos?page=1&limit=5 with a valid JWT should return a paginated docs array; a bad userId should 400.
steps.outcome: Filter by userId (with published/unpublished visibility rule for the owner), optional title/description regex search, sortBy/sortType, paginated via the existing mongoose-aggregate-paginate-v2 plugin already attached to the Video model.

steps.context: Implemented in the same video.controller.js rewrite.
steps.implementation_outline: Validate title/description present, get videoFile+thumbnail local paths from req.files (multer .fields), upload both to Cloudinary, pull duration from Cloudinary response, create Video doc with owner=req.user._id, consistent with registerUser's multer/cloudinary pattern
steps.verification: Manual review against registerUser's multer/cloudinary pattern for consistency. Real verification: POST /api/v1/videos/publish with videoFile+thumbnail form fields and a valid JWT should return 201 with a created video doc containing Cloudinary URLs.
steps.outcome: Validates title/description, extracts videoFile+thumbnail from req.files (multer .fields pattern matching registerUser), uploads both to Cloudinary, creates the Video doc with owner=req.user._id, duration pulled from Cloudinary's response.

steps.context: Implemented in the same video.controller.js rewrite.
steps.implementation_outline: Validate ObjectId, fetch video populated with owner (fullName/username/avatar), increment views count, 404 if not found
steps.verification: Manual review. Real verification: GET /api/v1/videos/:videoId increments views by 1 each call and returns populated owner info; a non-owner requesting an unpublished video should get 404.
steps.outcome: Validates ObjectId, fetches video populated with owner (fullName/userName/avatar), blocks access to unpublished videos for non-owners, increments views count on each fetch.

steps.context: Implemented in the same video.controller.js rewrite.
steps.implementation_outline: Validate ObjectId, ownership check (only owner can update), allow updating title/description/thumbnail (thumbnail via multer single file + cloudinary re-upload), consistent with updateUserAvatar pattern
steps.verification: Manual review against updateUserAvatar pattern. Real verification: PATCH /api/v1/videos/:videoId as non-owner returns 403; as owner with new title returns 200 with updated doc.
steps.outcome: Validates ObjectId + ownership, allows updating title/description, optional thumbnail re-upload via req.file (multer single-file pattern matching updateUserAvatar).

steps.context: Implemented in the same video.controller.js rewrite.
steps.implementation_outline: Validate ObjectId, ownership check, delete the Video document (simple deleteOne, no Cloudinary cleanup to keep it medium-complexity, matches deleteTweet pattern)
steps.verification: Manual review against deleteTweet pattern. Real verification: DELETE /api/v1/videos/:videoId as non-owner returns 403; as owner returns 200 and the doc no longer appears in getAllVideos.
steps.outcome: Validates ObjectId + ownership, deletes the Video document via deleteOne(), matching deleteTweet's pattern. Cloudinary asset cleanup intentionally omitted to keep this at medium complexity, per user's request.

steps.context: Implemented in the same video.controller.js rewrite.
steps.implementation_outline: Validate ObjectId, ownership check, flip isPublished boolean and save
steps.verification: Manual review. Real verification: PATCH /api/v1/videos/toggle/publish/:videoId flips isPublished on each call, confirmed by re-fetching the doc.
steps.outcome: Validates ObjectId + ownership, flips isPublished boolean, saves with validateBeforeSave:false (consistent with other toggle-style updates in the codebase).

steps.content: Create video.routes.js and register in app.js
steps.context: Created video.routes.js mirroring tweet.routes.js structure and registered it in app.js.
steps.implementation_outline: Mirror tweet.routes.js structure: verifyJWT on all routes, upload.fields for publish (videoFile+thumbnail), upload.single for thumbnail update, import and app.use('/api/v1/videos', videoRouter) in app.js
steps.verification: Manual review: route paths don't collide with existing routers (users/tweets/likes/comments), import path is correct relative to app.js. Real verification: npm run dev should start without errors, and GET /api/v1/videos should return a 401 without a token, 200 with one.
steps.outcome: video.routes.js created with: GET / (list), POST /publish (multer .fields for videoFile+thumbnail), GET/PATCH/DELETE /:videoId (PATCH uses multer .single thumbnail), PATCH /toggle/publish/:videoId. verifyJWT applied to all routes via router.use(). Registered in app.js as app.use('/api/v1/videos', videoRouter), import placed alongside the other route imports.

plans.title: Complete comment.controller.js - Media Sharing Platform backend
plans.purpose: Complete the unfinished comment.controller.js functions (getVideoComments, addComment, updateComment, deleteComment) at medium complexity, consistent with tweet.controller.js/video.controller.js style, and fix bugs found in comment.routes.js while wiring it up.

steps.content: Fix broken import path in comment.controller.js
steps.context: Fixed as part of rewriting the full comment.controller.js file.
steps.implementation_outline: Same bug as video.controller.js had - imports from '../utils/ApiError.js' but actual file is 'ApiErrors.js'
steps.verification: Manual review: import path now matches actual filename ApiErrors.js. Real verification: npm run dev starts without a module-not-found error.
steps.outcome: Corrected import from '../utils/ApiError.js' to '../utils/ApiErrors.js', same bug pattern as video.controller.js had.

steps.implementation_outline: Validate videoId, paginate comments for that video using mongoose-aggregate-paginate-v2 (already on the model), populate owner (fullName/userName/avatar), sort newest first
steps.verification: Manual review against getUserChannelProfile's $lookup+$addFields pattern already used in the codebase. Real verification: GET /api/v1/comments/get-vid-comments/:videoId returns paginated comments with owner info populated.
steps.outcome: Validates videoId, aggregates+paginates comments for that video via mongoose-aggregate-paginate-v2, sorted newest-first, with owner populated (fullName/userName/avatar) via $lookup+$addFields.

steps.implementation_outline: Validate videoId + content present, create Comment with owner=req.user._id and video=videoId
steps.verification: Manual review against createTweet pattern. Real verification: POST /api/v1/comments/add-comment/:videoId with {content} returns 201 with the created comment.
steps.outcome: Validates videoId + content present, creates Comment with owner=req.user._id and video=videoId, mirrors createTweet's validation style.

steps.implementation_outline: Validate commentId, ownership check (only owner can edit), update content field, mirrors updateTweet's ownership pattern
steps.verification: Manual review against updateTweet pattern. Real verification: PATCH /api/v1/comments/update-comment/:commentId as non-owner returns 403; as owner returns 200 with updated content.
steps.outcome: Validates commentId, ownership check (only owner can edit), updates content field - mirrors updateTweet's ownership-check pattern exactly.

steps.implementation_outline: Validate commentId, ownership check, deleteOne(), mirrors deleteTweet's pattern
steps.verification: Manual review against deleteTweet pattern. Real verification: DELETE /api/v1/comments/delete-comment/:commentId as non-owner returns 403; as owner returns 200 and the comment no longer appears in getVideoComments.
steps.outcome: Validates commentId, ownership check, deleteOne() - mirrors deleteTweet's pattern exactly.

steps.context: Fixed both bugs found in comment.routes.js during review.
steps.implementation_outline: Add missing leading slash to '/get-vid-comments/:videoId' route, change deleteComment route from .patch() to .delete() to match REST semantics used elsewhere (tweet/video routes)
